deliver: Implement narrow main-process broker using isolated Session partition per approved server/installation and fixed operation allowlist.
Login window uses the same partition; preserve issuer/tenant/resource membership and current provider grants.
Validate mainFrame sender and owner generation; abort/remove cookies on logout and owner disposal.
Downloads/upload pickers follow existing desktop permission/save-dialog paths; renderer cannot choose arbitrary URLs or headers.
Implement broker.test.ts inside the owned main/sucafina subtree; fixture asserts sender, operation allowlist, owner epoch, cookie partition and upload/download mediation.

Use existing authenticated AppDockSocket per-launch channel for local enrollment: main/CLI request-reply stays outside HTTP and renderer; no token stdout/log/cookie import. Explicit unmanaged loopback chooser parses original open-local.html only as data.

Use the exact four entrypoints and constructor dependencies from CONTRACTS §6.1. Approved connection registry and lifecycle are injected by I00; serverKey received from a renderer never approves or registers a connection.

Native connection consent uses only COPY-02/SF_DESKTOP_COPY and SF_DESKTOP_COPY_BR in the owned main copy.ts. Cancel is default/cancelId 0; main never imports APP dictionaries. Register and release use exact generation-bound typed channels; a connection can be released before bind.

For remote ids selection, do not require Location.directory from unrelated current SDK owner; registry registration still validates connection+consent, then broker uses loaded installation identity. Auth return marker is dashboard?sf=native-return with opaque one-use ref, not new /auth/native-return exception.

acceptance_cases.expected: oc://renderer can complete authorized business read/action through broker; web success alone does not qualify desktop.
Wrong sender, stale owner, unknown operation, URL/header injection and cross-install partition are rejected before request.
Logout invalidates in-flight results and session state; no secret/cookie enters renderer storage or logs.
Remote deep link A loads after prior connection B, login return stays in Session partition and validates original A; no renderer token or URL injection; auth marker expires and cannot be reused.

gates.incremental: Use canonical ci_plan.dispatch_policy.incremental_validation and invalidation_matrix; exact changed specs plus transitive consumers, one dispatcher.
gates.execute_after: INTEGRATED and readiness satisfied; dispatcher resolves existing aliases before any request. Never invent workflow, runner or service.
gates.final: Canonical same-C gates remain; this work order cannot declare GLOBAL_RELEASE.
gates.typecheck_command: bun typecheck in each named package directory through the authorized compiler-only executor; never tsc directly.

stop: Unknown field, action, error, permission, route, export or schema => BLOCKED_CONTRACT for that output; publish exact question and source evidence; finish other independent authorized outputs.
Producer changed since locked family pin => BLOCKED_DRIFT for affected consumers; never silently rebase semantics or widen validation.
Required path outside owns or active foreign lease => BLOCKED_OWNER; provide complete inert patch to I00/current owner.
Live service absent => ARTIFACT_READY plus BLOCKED_INTEGRATION/QUALIFICATION; no stub, permissive substitute or synthetic receipt in production.
A failing unchanged input must not be rerun until causal change or a documented transient infrastructure cause is established.
No full-suite dispatch, merge, deploy, Azure, auth policy, financial rule or producer-engine change from this work order.

handoff.format: Canonical executor receipt plus protocol fields; source commit/tree, exact path/blob preimages/postimages, contracts digests, exports, tests not run/run evidence, blockers, consumer list, lease terminal.
handoff.slot_release: ARTIFACT_READY may be per named incremental output. After receipt and explicit owner handoff, release slot; next actor needs new bounded lease. No idle wait and no inferred expiry.
handoff.shared_changes: Exact proposed diff with preimage/postimage; I00 applies only after current owner release, without rewriting the author output.
